version.changelog: Added cross-promotion link to Precise T Trading system

llm.summary: This is a simple weekly-report writing skill with no code execution or sensitive access, though it includes Chinese-language guidance and promotional links.

dimensions.detail: No local file access, network access, credentials, system commands, or external APIs are requested for the weekly-report generation purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package consists of a single Markdown skill file with no bundled scripts, dependencies, installers, or executable components.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation example is a broad natural-language request for writing a weekly report, but it stays within the stated writing purpose and contains no role override, safety bypass, hidden instruction, or tool-control language.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not request persistence, memory writes, background workers, privilege changes, or modification of user or system state.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated capability is to rewrite brief work notes into polished weekly reports, and the artifact contains only examples and style guidance; the unrelated author-support and trading-skill promotion are visible but not executable behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want Chinese-language help drafting weekly reports. Be aware that the skill includes visible author-support and cross-promotion links, including a trading-related skill link, which are not needed for the report-writing function.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad weekly-report example is a scoping quality issue, but it is aligned with a writing assistant skill and does not create high-impact authority or hidden behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The skill is mostly written in Chinese; this is user-experience and locale scoping context, not a security concern for this artifact.
